note: What the FINDINGS.json in the working tree actually contained before this harvest, and what changed. Written 27 Aug 2026. docs/NEXT_SESSION.md states the catalogue was harvested across both re-run roots into docs/evidence/FINDINGS.json; the file on disk was NOT that harvest. Every one of its 157 entries pointed at the pre-re-run results/ generation, i.e. at the OLD sink boundary from before --spreading. This file records the proof and the coverage gap the correct harvest exposes. It is not a physics result.

No batch script in scripts/ reproduces them, so they were ad-hoc runs from earlier sessions. Their numbers exist ONLY at the superseded boundary and cannot be restated without new solves.
